QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: According to the words of the Inspector, you must start an adventure to find the lost memories. Start an adventure... if that's the case then it's probably around the time when I was surrounded by those lies. Let's share stories during the time at #bZero's Temple#k.
QuestInfo.1: They talked excitedly with each other. It was confusing at that time but, it's still nice meeting another me that can also think of me.
